description: Crypto market data: precomputed RSI-14, MACD and Bollinger Bands plus latest OKX perp funding for BTC, ETH and SOL, or one coin via symbol= (bad symbol: 400), with no candle fetching needed. JSON per asset: rsi14, macd {macd, signal, histogram} (null if too few candles), bollinger, lastClose, funding. From CoinGecko OHLC closes (Coinbase fallback); methodology included. Descriptive only, not a forecast and not financial advice. Errors are not charged on Base (other rails may charge). Price $0.005 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Data changes about every 5 min; calling more often returns the same values.
